description:
From the fz-kdt.192 cold review (2026-09-03, probes X5/X5B), pre-existing at
8de517a28. types/mod.rs:644 mint_brand(inner, name) produces `inner | Brand`,
so is_subtype(mint_brand(int, "Meters"), int) = false and is_subtype(int,
mint_brand(int, "Meters")) = true -- a branded value is a strict supertype of
its inner. At HEAD the pattern-derived witness hid the consequence at @spec
positions; once the witness is the raw argument (fz-kdt.192) the structural
gate `witness ⊆ σ(P)` REJECTS a branded argument at a ground `int` position
(X5: `({int, a}) :: a` at {Meters, int} → Invalid, base Known by
restatement) and ACCEPTS a bare int at a branded position (X5B). Whether
that is the intended model (fz-bsx: runtime equality/matching brand-blind,
typing brand-aware; a brand is a nominal refinement, i.e. a SUBTYPE of its
inner) or an inversion must be decided and pinned before 192 makes the
rejection reachable in user programs. Corpus today: 0 movers (no fixture
passes a branded value to a ground-int spec position). CONCORDANT: fz-bsx
(the brand model), fz-kdt.169 (brand-erased forwarder keys), fz-kdt.192.
title: mint_brand unions the brand into its inner type, so a branded value is a strict SUPERTYPE of the inner: a ground `int` spec position rejects a Meters argument and accepts a bare int at a branded position -- confirm the brand model before witnesses become observations
